summary_en: Appier Group raised its full-year dividend forecast for the year ending December 2026 from 2.30 yen to 2.50 yen per share, following an upward revision of earnings forecasts. Operating profit is now projected at 5,854 million yen (up 16.3% from prior forecast), with net income attributable to parent at 4,991 million yen (up 21.1%), reflecting improved gross margin from agentic AI deployment and disciplined expense management.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending December 2026
translation_en_brief:
Appier Group, Inc. revised upward its financial forecasts for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Operating profit is now expected to reach 5,854 million yen, up 16.3 percent from the prior forecast, while net income attributable to parent is projected at 4,991 million yen, representing a 21.1 percent increase. Gross margin improved beyond expectations due to the deployment of agentic AI, which accelerated the R&D cycle and drove algorithm improvements and industry-specific AI model enhancements. The company also benefited from continued efficiency gains in AI-driven business automation and disciplined management of operating expenses, which grew at a slower rate than gross profit expansion.

As a result of these improvements and the benefits to working capital, core free cash flow turned positive during the nine-month period ended September 2026. Reflecting this operational progress, the company increased its annual dividend forecast per share from 2.30 yen to 2.50 yen for the fiscal year. The prior forecast had been announced on August 13, 2026. Revenue is unchanged from the prior forecast at 54,381 million yen, as existing operations advanced steadily across Northeast Asia, the United States, and the EMEA region.
